FOOTNOTES

1/ The appropriation is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (FY 2025 General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$2,150,900 and 13 FTE Positions from the Dental Board Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Annual Leave Payout

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for an Annual Leave Payout. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

The FY 2025 budget included \$9,300 from the Dental Board Fund for a one-time annual leave payout. This appropriation is non-lapsing. As of this writing, the appropriation has not yet been spent.
